releases.notes:
# Settings UI & new Gamerule

- Now you can set gamerules easily with a interface! Type the command: `/function forgecraft_lpmc2:settings` to start the menu.
- New Gamerule: **IsTextureEquipment**. Just like IsTextureArmor, it determine if forging set the item model texture. You cannot reverse this action for the items that are already applied.

releases.notes:
# Important Fix for server side performace
- Reduced the memory usage of checking player's current slot detection.
- The system won't keep ticking the inventory changed detection when opening chest (This is the core issue why this is happening!!!)
- Btw, tip for inputting Spear weapon into slot: Just try to distant yourself and the anvil for a bit, and try click on the slots! Or you can quick switch while left clicking. This problem only exist after a few snapshots in 1.21.11 and it's certainly not my problem.

This fix should greatly improve the server performance. If needed, I will try to further optimize the system.
